examples.text: Riding the rollercoaster was a frightening experience.

examples.text: That was an appalling waste of money.

examples.text: True, there were the usual night-sounds of the country—the whir of night-birds, the buzzing of insects, the barking of distant dogs, the mellow lowing of far-off kine—but these didn't seem to break the stillness, they only intensified it, and added a grewsome melancholy to it into the bargain.
